scope: Proposition 9.8 (Protected exterior correction) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 108. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an integer s ≥ 3. Suppose dB = (δ + aB, bB) are smooth data on R3, the metric is positive, and all derivatives of aB, bB have symbol orders −1, −2, respectively. Suppose a smooth compact source ϕ, supported in {|y′| ≥ 1}, agrees with Φ(dB) there. If ∥aB∥Hs+2 1 + ∥bB∥Hs+1 2 + ∥ϕ∥Hs 4 is sufficiently small, there is a smooth correction vc supported in {|y′| ≥ 1} such that Φ(dB + vc) = 0 there, ∥vc∥Xs ≤ Cs∥ϕ∥Hs 4 . The correction is smooth across the support boundary, preserves positivity, and satisfies symbol bounds at every order. There is no higher-order smallness assumption and no condition on the artificial interior defect. No moment condition is imposed on ϕ; the correction may have a noncompact tail changing the asymptotic coefficients.
